meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行指令编排视频内容,自动完成渲染与发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望用脚本化方式制作和渲染视频,不想依赖图形界面。
copy.tagline_en: Create and render videos via command line, from keyframes to cloud targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer scripted video work over manual editing.

howto.what: 让 Claude 使用 HyperFrames CLI 做视频项目：初始化、查现成动画、写合成、跑 lint/check、预览、渲染成片，也能诊断构建/渲染失败。覆盖本地、云端、AWS Lambda、Google Cloud Run。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建或编辑 HyperFrames 视频、排查构建/渲染失败，或直接要求运行 hyperframes 相关命令时。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes init 新开一个视频项目
say.note: 会初始化项目骨架并进入开发流程。

say.text: 在 catalog 里搜“标题逐行显现”的动画
say.note: 会在本地目录中搜索并推荐可安装的预设。

say.text: 渲染前先跑 hyperframes check 把把关
say.note: 先跑一遍 lint，再在浏览器里做合成检查。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to run the HyperFrames CLI pipeline for video work: scaffold with init, find ready animations in the catalog, author compositions, lint/check, preview, render, and diagnose build/render failures. Local, hosted cloud, Lambda, and Cloud Run supported.
howto.when_en: When the user wants to build or edit a HyperFrames video, fix render/build failures, or asks for any hyperframes-related command.

say_en.text: Set up a new HyperFrames project with hyperframes init.
say_en.note: Scaffolds the project and starts the loop.

say_en.text: Search the catalog for a headline-reveal animation.
say_en.note: Runs a local search and suggests installation if found.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes check before the final render.
say_en.note: Runs lint then a browser preview audit.
